name: Jambres
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: “Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth”. Those sorcerers, witches and warlocks resisted God back then. The same demons are back on this earth, resisting this truth, fighting the word of God and fighting change. Our people want change, but they don't want to change.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel
